maria.k: Hi team — I’m on my first shadow rotation next week and want to confirm a few things. Who should I ping if I need a quick swap, and where do I find the 'page handling' runbook?

jamal: Welcome aboard, Maria! :wave: For swaps, ping @olivia_ops first — she coordinates the rota. If she’s unavailable, DM me. Runbook is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks/page-handling (you'll need SSO access).

maria.k: Thanks — SSO is still pending for me. I filled the access request form yesterday. Should I do anything else to get the runbook?

olivia_ops: If SSO is pending, reply to this thread with your email and I’ll add a temporary viewer link. Also please run through the shadow checklist below before your first shift:

```
- Confirm pager routing on your account (okta id)
- Read Page Handling runbook (link above)
- Run the local incident playbook locally: `./scripts/runbook-check.sh`
- Join #eng-oncall 15m before shift start
- Add emergency contact on PagerDuty
```

sam_sre: Two quick notes: 1) If you get a database connection spike on LLM-serving, triage steps are in the runbook under "DB spikes". 2) For model fallback incidents, we have a short runbook snippet you can paste into incident Slack channels:

```
Model fallback - quick triage:
1) Check model pool health: `rictl pools status --model $MODEL`
2) If pool degraded, route to fallback: `rictl route set --route fallback-$MODEL`
3) Notify #eng-runtime and post incident template
```

maria.k: Awesome. Can someone add the shadow pairing to the calendar? I was assigned 2026-04-01 10:00-14:00 but need to confirm pairing with an experienced oncall.

olivia_ops: I’ll add you with @jamal as the primary shadow mentor. Calendar invite sent.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-01 09:30 UTC for inference-runtime v2.3.1 — expect minor API latency fluctuation.

maria.k: Good to know — should I mute pages during canary?

jamal: No, don’t mute. Canary may generate noise and is a good learning opportunity. If it’s noisy and not actionable, mark as noisy and we’ll adjust. If it’s actionable, follow the runbook and escalate to OLIVIA/ME.

olivia_ops: Also — small tip: add a bookmark to the runbook subsection anchors (DB spikes, Model fallback, Escalation matrix). Saves time during high pressure.

maria.k: One last question: is there a preferred short template for incident summaries I should practice?

sam_sre: Use this minimal template for your first summaries — keep it concise:

```
Summary: <1-line summary>
Impact: <who/how many/what degraded>
Timeline: <HH:MM short bullets>
Root cause (tentative): <one line>
Actions taken: <bullets>
Next steps: <bullets>
Owner: <your name>
```

maria.k: Thanks everyone — this is super helpful. I’ll confirm when SSO is live and mark myself ready for the shadow shift. :thumbsup:

jamal: Any other questions ping me or @olivia_ops. See you on shift! :rocket:
